line_rules.title: Dynamic code evaluation
line_rules.recommendation: Replace dynamic evaluation with a strict parser or an explicit operation allowlist.

line_rules.title: Shell-enabled subprocess execution
line_rules.recommendation: Disable shell execution and pass a fixed executable with a validated argument list.

line_rules.title: Untrusted shell interpretation
line_rules.recommendation: Use direct process execution with shell disabled and validate every argument.

line_rules.title: Command execution API
line_rules.recommendation: Use a fixed command allowlist and an argument-array API without a shell.

line_rules.title: Interpolated database query
line_rules.recommendation: Use a parameterized query and bind all untrusted values through the database driver.

line_rules.title: Detached asynchronous task
line_rules.recommendation: Retain and await the task, use a task group, or attach explicit exception handling.

line_rules.title: Asynchronous failure may be swallowed
line_rules.recommendation: Handle expected exceptions explicitly and propagate or record unexpected failures.

line_rules.title: File handle may leak
line_rules.recommendation: Open the file with a context manager or close it in a guaranteed finally block.

line_rules.title: Hard-coded credential
line_rules.recommendation: Remove the credential from source, rotate it, and load it from an approved secret manager.

line_rules.title: Credential-like token in source
line_rules.recommendation: Remove and rotate the token, then retrieve it at runtime from an approved secret manager.

line_rules.title: Private key material in source
line_rules.recommendation: Remove and rotate the private key, then store it in an approved secret manager.

line_rules.title: Credential embedded in URL
line_rules.recommendation: Remove credentials from the URL, rotate them, and inject them from a secret manager.
